post.name: Fallout 76 Daily Update
post.body:
**Atomic Shop**
* .44 Gold Paint (200⚛️ (50% off!)), Leaves on (28-Jul-2026)
* Scaled Axolotl (Free), Leaves on (4-Aug-2026)
* Prime Mover Generator (Fallout 1st) (Free), Leaves on (4-Aug-2026)
* Vined Garden Archway (250⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)
* Garden Party Bundle (2000⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)
* Off-road Vehicle (500⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)
* Red Cedar Hedge (250⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)
* Grunt Greenery (200⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)
* Turf War Bundle (1400⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)
* American Trucker Cap (400⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)
* Road Rash Bundle (1800⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)
* Weed Killer Auto-Axe Paint (500⚛️), Leaves on (11-Aug-2026)

**Current Events**
* Summer Sock Hop Mini Season Week 1, Ends on (28-Jul-2026)
* Summer Sock Hop Mini Season, Ends on (4-Aug-2026)
* Season 25: Appalachia Under Siege, Estimated end date (1-Sep-2026)

**Fishing**
* Scaled Axolotl, Regions: Forest & Ash Heap, Changes on: (4-Aug-2026)
* Fernskipper, Regions: Cranberry Bog, Mire, Skyline Drive, Changes on: (22-Sep-2026)
* Glass Ghost, Location: Glassed Cavern, Changes on: (22-Sep-2026)

**Summer Sock Hop Mini Season Week 1**
* Complete a Week 1 Summer Sock Hop Challenge (7x) 🎟️145
* Use the "Shimmy Dance" Emote at another Player's C.A.M.P. 🎟️15
* Use the "Shimmy Dance" Emote at Sandy's Sock Hop 🎟️15
* Use the "Shimmy Dance" Emote at Berkeley Springs 🎟️15
* Use the "Shimmy Dance" Emote at Black Bear Lodge 🎟️15
* Use the "Shimmy Dance" Emote at Camden Park 🎟️15
* Use the "Shimmy Dance" Emote during an Event or Activity 🎟️15
* Kill a Blood Eagle while on a Team (76x) 🎟️15

**Daily Challenges**
* 1ˢᵗ  Collect a Teapot (x2) 250
*  ⭐ Gold Star: Complete a Daily Challenge (x6) 1000
*   Complete an Event or Activity (x1) 250
*   Drink Nuka-Cola Cranberry (x2) 250
*   Eat a Vegetable (x10) 250
*   Harvest Corn, Razorgrain, or a Tato Plant (x12) 250
*   Kill an Enemy in the Cranberry Bog Region (x5) 250
*   Sell Glowing Fungus Soup to an NPC vendor (x1) 250

**Minerva's Location: Away**
She will next be at The Whitespring Resort on 30-Jul-2026

**Daily OPS: Uplink**
* Location: The Burning Mine
* Enemy Faction: Communists
* Enemy Mutations: Piercing Gaze, Freezing Touch
